cgv.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale
cgv.s1text: These Terms and Conditions of Sale govern all sales of website audit reports made by WebPulse (hereinafter "the Service").
cgv.s2text: WebPulse provides an automated website audit service analyzing performance, SEO and accessibility. The service comes in two plans:
cgv.s2free: Free Plan: summary scores and preview of the top 5 issues.
cgv.s2pro: Pro Report (€9): full report with all detailed issues, recommendations and headings structure.
cgv.s3text: The Pro report is sold at a unit price of €9 incl. tax. Payment is made by credit card via the secure Stripe platform. The report is accessible immediately after payment confirmation.
cgv.s4text: In accordance with applicable consumer protection laws, the right of withdrawal does not apply to digital content provided immediately after purchase. By confirming your order, you expressly agree that the report will be provided immediately and waive your right of withdrawal.
cgv.s5text: The report is generated and instantly accessible online after payment. It can be downloaded in HTML format and printed as PDF from your browser.
cgv.s6text: WebPulse provides automated analysis based on publicly accessible HTML content. Results are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute professional advice. WebPulse does not guarantee the completeness or absolute accuracy of the results.
cgv.s7text: Generated reports are the property of the buyer. The design, source code and WebPulse brand remain the exclusive property of WebPulse.
cgv.s8text: For any questions regarding these terms, contact us at:

privacy.s1url: Website URL audited — required to perform the analysis.
privacy.s1ip: IP address — used only for rate limiting.
privacy.s1payment: Payment data — processed exclusively by Stripe. WebPulse does not have access to your banking information.
privacy.s2report: Generating and delivering the audit report.
privacy.s3text1: Audit results are stored temporarily and are automatically deleted after 24 hours.
privacy.s3text2: No user account is created. No personal data is permanently stored by WebPulse.
privacy.s4text: WebPulse does not use tracking or marketing cookies. Only technical cookies necessary for the site to function may be used.
privacy.s5text: WebPulse does not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties, except for Stripe for payment processing.
